shared_detector_infrastructure.merge_identity: Same exact detector-returned UTF-8 value -> process-scoped random-key HMAC-SHA256; merge detector metadata and all locations; one finding keyed by provider and fingerprint. No fuzzy/trim/case-fold merge.
shared_detector_infrastructure.scope_limit: One collector process/key domain. Forks reset the random HMAC key, so cross-process/cross-scan merge is not guaranteed and must not be claimed.
shared_detector_infrastructure.no_verification: Kingfisher detection-only Scanner; no Validator/Revoker. TruffleHog stdin --no-verification --no-update --no-verification-cache --force-skip-archives; no scanner credential validation or rotation.
shared_detector_infrastructure.negative_requires: Both pinned engines complete on all selected supported bounded bytes; missing/failing engines or partial selection cannot prove whole-service secret absence.
shared_detector_infrastructure.proof_limit: Code inspection plus attributed existing mocked boundary tests; this inventory does not run real scanners, cloud APIs or network verification.

proposed_global_content_policy.bounded_archive_policy: Manual bounded decompression only; reject path traversal, links, encrypted members, unsupported archives, recursion/size/ratio limits. Do not execute or extract onto host filesystem; TruffleHog archive traversal stays disabled.
proposed_global_content_policy.concurrency: One scan-wide deadline and total-byte/request budget shared across all selected resources; per-page/parallel-worker resets cannot bypass the total.
proposed_global_content_policy.unsupported: Record explicit incomplete/unsupported status and coverage reason; never infer clean from skipped files, binary formats, denied reads, mutable references or missing detectors.

next_adapter.runtime_ownership: Historical first-adapter design retained for traceability; installed selected-object reader has separate current acceptance.
next_adapter.first_scope: Exact selected UTF-8 text objects only; no list/prefix/archive traversal in first increment.
integration_prerequisites: Root-owned typed bounded byte-stream reader with response length/content-encoding checks, no raw JSON cache or redirects.
Explicit content option/schema/planner selection; immutable bucket/object/generation binding.
Use shared dual detectors and process HMAC domain; sanitize before evidence/cache, deduplicate findings in engine.
reusable_for: Functions GCS source references after separate bounded archive support
directed_acceptance: Default off performs no object-content request or scanner call.
Exact metadata identity/generation and conditional media read agree; generation mismatch is incomplete.
Transport streaming/decoded bytes and scan-wide budget reject oversize before accumulation.
Same exact token found by both tools and in two resources emits one redacted finding with all locations.

test_results.limitations: Offline inventory validation and selected mocked boundaries only; no native content adapter certification, live cloud, installed scanner execution or network verification.
